title: PLC MCP internal worker protocol v1
description: Internal JSON envelope v1 with additive managed editing and engineering configuration. Runtime validation checks operation-specific rules, identities, revision scope, bounded values and save/reopen proofs. Schema validity is not vendor compatibility evidence. P4 adds bounded exchange queries, content-addressed XML import and graph operations. Validation scopes and warnings never imply vendor compatibility. P5 batch and package are application-coordinator operations, not vendor SDK methods. Exchange private-file integrity and graph semantic limits are validated separately at runtime. P6 adds adopt/restore/context/diff/text.patch application operations and the vendor object.source.read port. Historical revisions are m2 manifests; context and diffs are bounded read projections, not a PLC database.

xml.description: UTF-8 byte limit checked at runtime. Wire JSON keeps <=64 KiB inline; larger XML uses the fixed private file. Application imports hydrate artifactId immediately before execution.
